enemy.name: Wooden Burdenbeast of Ilion
enemy.flavour_text: The wooden burdenbeast of Ilion, played by Minoan citizens. In the age of city states, Athenians captured the previously impregnable city of Ilion by hiding soldiers inside a wooden burdenbeast. The story is so well-known that a group of Minoans squeezing themselves into a vehicle is immediately understood as a recreation of the legend, and onlookers are invited to join in.

abilities.text: Movement Speed reduced for each additional passenger
